title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
subtitle: Foundational
description: Foundational knowledge of AWS Cloud concepts, security, technology, services, and billing practices. Suitable for non-technical and technical roles.

title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
subtitle: Associate Level
description: Design secure, resilient, high-performing, and cost-optimized architectures on AWS using the Well-Architected Framework.

title: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
subtitle: Associate Level
description: Develop, test, deploy, and debug cloud-based applications on AWS using SDKs, Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, and CI/CD pipelines.

title: AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate
subtitle: Associate Level
description: Deploy, manage, and operate workloads on AWS. Focus on monitoring, automation, security, and troubleshooting in AWS environments

title: AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate
subtitle: Associate Level (New)
description: Implement data pipelines, manage data stores, and apply security and governance for data solutions on AWS using Kinesis, Glue, Redshift, Athena, and more.
experience_recommended: 2-3 years data engineering experience, 1-2 years AWS

title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
subtitle: Professional Level
description: Advanced architectural design for complex, multi-account AWS environments including migration, organizational design, and continuous improvement.

title: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
subtitle: Professional Level
description: Provision, operate, and manage distributed systems on AWS with CI/CD, IaC, SRE practices, monitoring, incident response, and security compliance.

title: AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty
subtitle: Specialty
description: Design, implement, manage, and secure AWS and hybrid network architectures at scale including VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and network security.

title: AWS Certified Security – Specialty
subtitle: Specialty
description: Design and implement security solutions on AWS including detection, incident response, infrastructure security, IAM, data protection, and governance. Current version SCS-C03 (active Dec 2, 2025).

title: AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty
subtitle: Specialty
description: Design, build, secure, and maintain analytics solutions on AWS. NOTE: AWS has effectively superseded DAS-C01 with the DEA-C01 Data Engineer Associate cert.

title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
subtitle: Foundational / Emerging GenAI (New)
description: Foundational understanding of AI/ML and generative AI concepts, AWS AI tools, foundation models, responsible AI, and security for AI solutions.
experience_recommended: Up to 6 months AI/ML on AWS
